Name: Kenneth's Tropical Farm
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Tropical Farm - Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds a tropical farm expansion inspired by Southeast Asia.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes 16 new crops such as Amaryllis, Aromatic Ginger, Arum Lily, Bougainvillea, Chinese Hibiscus, Crown Daisy, Kaffir Lime Leaves, Lemongrass, Longan, Snakefruit, Turmeric, Yucca and more.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Includes 4 new fruit trees such as Frangipani, Jambu, Rambutan and Sweetsop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Includes new grocery ingredients such as Coconut Cream, Palm Sugar, Fish Sauce, Oyster Sauce and others.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Includes flower vases for decoration.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Includes 6 new cooking recipes such as Djamu, Grass Jelly Milk Tea, Lemongrass Tea, Tropical Fruit Punch and more.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All crops are seasonal and balanced for vanilla gameplay. Some are regrowable and some are trellis crops.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Seeds and saplings are sold at Kenneth's Seed Shop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Grocery ingredients and vases are sold at Kenneth's Grocery Store.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Designed to fit naturally into the game with no clutter.[/b][/size]
